title: My Son-in-Law Called the Kids Next Door Brats and Told a Judge I Hear Things. Then the Boy Played.
description:
My son-in-law stood on my porch, pointed at the little blue house next door and called the two children inside brats. Sign the complaint, Mae, he said. They're gone by Christmas, or you're going to Pine Haven.

He didn't know the little girl next door had been keeping a notebook. And none of us knew who taught that boy the song he played every afternoon at four, until the night of the town talent show.
